evidence.title: Newsom signs first-in-nation law forcing major companies to reveal slavery-era ties: 'Make it public'

occurrences.checkable_against: California Assembly Bill 2599 affidavit filing deadline and platform development records
occurrences.quote_span: For companies doing business in California as of Jan. 1, 2028, the first affidavits are due by Jan. 15, 2029, or later if the state's platform has not yet been developed.
occurrences.speaker: Fox News Digital
occurrences.subject: California Assembly Bill 2599

occurrences.checkable_against: California legislative committee records and insurance industry statements on Assembly Bill 2599
occurrences.quote_span: The legislation faced opposition from several insurance industry groups, including the American Council of Life Insurers and American Property Casualty Insurance Association.
occurrences.speaker: Fox News Digital
occurrences.subject: California Assembly Bill 2599

occurrences.checkable_against: California Insurance Code and California Department of Insurance records
occurrences.quote_span: California has required insurers to research and disclose slavery-era insurance policies since 2000, and the state maintains those records through its Department of Insurance.
occurrences.speaker: Fox News Digital
occurrences.subject: California Assembly Bill 2599

occurrences.checkable_against: Natalie Baldassarre comments to Fox News Digital
occurrences.quote_span: RNC Press Secretary Natalie Baldassarre criticized the law in comments to Fox News Digital.
occurrences.speaker: Natalie Baldassarre
occurrences.subject: California Assembly Bill 2599

occurrences.checkable_against: Natalie Baldassarre comments to Fox News Digital
occurrences.quote_span: RNC Press Secretary Natalie Baldassarre criticized the law in comments to Fox News Digital.
occurrences.speaker: Natalie Baldassarre
occurrences.subject: California Assembly Bill 2599

occurrences.checkable_against: California Assembly Bill 2599 legislative record and statutory text
occurrences.quote_span: Assembly Bill 2599, authored by Democratic Assemblymember Isaac Bryan, applies to businesses with more than $100 million in annual worldwide gross receipts that existed, or have a predecessor company that existed, on or before Dec. 31, 1964.
occurrences.speaker: Fox News Digital
occurrences.subject: California Assembly Bill 2599

occurrences.checkable_against: California Assembly Bill 2599 statutory text and California state digital platform records
occurrences.quote_span: The law also calls for the records to become publicly accessible through a state digital platform.
occurrences.speaker: Fox News Digital
occurrences.subject: California Assembly Bill 2599

occurrences.checkable_against: California Senate Judiciary Committee analysis of Assembly Bill 2599
occurrences.quote_span: The California Senate Judiciary Committee’s analysis of the bill said five insurance industry groups opposed the bill, including the American Council of Life Insurers, the Association of California Life and Health Insurance Companies and the American Property Casualty Insurance Association.
occurrences.speaker: California Senate Judiciary Committee
occurrences.subject: California Assembly Bill 2599

occurrences.checkable_against: California enacted legislation and governor signing record for Assembly Bill 2599
occurrences.quote_span: California Gov. Gavin Newsom signed a first-in-the-nation law Wednesday requiring large companies doing business in the state to scour historical records and publicly disclose slavery-era transactions, advancing California's broader reparations effort through a new corporate "accountability" mandate.
occurrences.speaker: Fox News Digital
occurrences.subject: California Assembly Bill 2599

occurrences.checkable_against: California Assembly Bill 2599 implementation and affidavit requirements
occurrences.quote_span: Once funded by the Legislature, covered companies must submit affidavits under penalty of perjury verifying searches for records involving the purchase or sale of enslaved people, their use as loan collateral, slave-related insurance and other transactions.
occurrences.speaker: Fox News Digital
occurrences.subject: California Assembly Bill 2599

occurrences.checkable_against: Gavin Newsom interview recording or transcript from Oct. 1, 2026
occurrences.quote_span: "This is a bill that requires large companies that operated before 1965 to search their records for ties to slavery going back to 1849 and then we make it public. These are insurance policies on enslaved people. Human beings used as collateral, quite literally as collateral for loans. Accountability, as Bryan said, starts with the truth," Newsom said.
occurrences.speaker: Gavin Newsom
occurrences.subject: California Assembly Bill 2599

occurrences.checkable_against: California Insurance Code section 13810 and SB 2199 compliance records
occurrences.quote_span: "AB 2599 appears to require reporting that substantially overlaps with the work already completed pursuant to SB 2199 and codified in CA INS 13810," the opponents said.
occurrences.speaker: AB 2599 opponents
occurrences.subject: California Assembly Bill 2599

occurrences.checkable_against: California affordability rankings and Natalie Baldassarre's statement to Fox News Digital
occurrences.quote_span: "California is already ranked the least affordable state in the nation, yet instead of cutting costs, Gavin Newsom is more worried about his future failed presidential run and placating to his far-left base. He's focused on literally anything but making California a safer, cleaner, and more affordable place to live,"Baldassarre said.
occurrences.speaker: Natalie Baldassarre
occurrences.subject: California Assembly Bill 2599

occurrences.checkable_against: California Senate Standing Committee on Public Safety hearing transcript
occurrences.quote_span: "For centuries, private corporations across the country benefited from chattel slavery," Bryan said during a Senate Standing Committee on Public Safety hearing. "They benefited from the economic wealth transfer of free labor."
occurrences.speaker: Isaac Bryan
occurrences.subject: California Assembly Bill 2599

occurrences.checkable_against: California Assembly Bill 2599 statutory text
occurrences.quote_span: Assembly Bill 2599, authored by Democratic Assemblymember Isaac Bryan, applies to businesses with more than $100 million in annual worldwide gross receipts that existed, or have a predecessor company that existed, on or before Dec. 31, 1964.
occurrences.speaker: Fox News Digital
occurrences.subject: California Assembly Bill 2599
